---
title: "Indirect effect of influenza vaccination coverage on the circulation of respiratory viruses"   
subtitle: "Supplementary Figure 17: Observed versus posterior predictive activity of other respiratory viruses across countries during the pre-pandemic period"
output: html_document
---
```{r}
packages <- c( "tidyverse","ggpubr")
lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE)

file_path <- "01.output_pre_pandemic_IAV"
dir.create(file_path)

plot_order <- c("RSV", "PIV", "RV", "ADV", "HMPV")
virus_vars <- c("ADV", "HMPV", "PIV", "RSV","RV")
```

## Prepare and save posterior predictive results
```{r eval=FALSE}
if (FALSE) {
plot_pred_list <- list()
for (j in 1:length(virus_vars))
{
print(virus_vars[j])

fig_out <- paste0(file_path,"/",j,".",virus_vars[j],"_figs")

# Load cross-validated posterior predictive summaries.
data$pred.mean <- NA
data$pred.median <- NA
data$pred.lci <- NA
data$pred.uci <- NA
pred_out <- paste0(file_path,"/",j,".",virus_vars[j],"_preds")

for (yyear in 1:4)
{
  for (mmonth in 1:12)
    
  {
    load(paste0(pred_out,"/preds_all_",2015 + yyear, "_",mmonth, ".RData"))
    data$pred.mean[preds$idx.pred] <- preds$mean
    data$pred.median[preds$idx.pred] <- preds$median
    data$pred.lci[preds$idx.pred] <- preds$lci
    data$pred.uci[preds$idx.pred] <- preds$uci
  }
}

# Retain variables required for posterior predictive analysis
plot_pred_list[[virus_vars[j]]] <- data %>%
```

## Load precomputed posterior predictive results
```{r}
# Load saved results to avoid time-consuming reanalysis
plot_pred_list <- readRDS("preds_virus_preCOVID.rds")
```

## Plot Supplementary Figure S17
```{r fig.width=9.45, fig.height=10, dpi=300, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
plot_list <- list()
plot_rows <- numeric()
n_col <- 9

for (j in 1:length(virus_vars)) {
# Load posterior predictive data for each virus
data <- plot_pred_list[[virus_vars[j]]]
# Prepare data for plotting
plot_dat <-data %>% 
  group_by(year_decimal, country) %>%
  summarise(cases = mean(cases_cases),
            fit = mean(pred.mean), 
            fit.lci = mean(pred.lci),
            fit.uci = mean(pred.uci),
            cases_year_sum = mean(cases_year)) %>% 
  # Calculate observed and posterior predictive RP (%)
  mutate( inc = ifelse(cases_year_sum == 0, NA, cases / cases_year_sum * 10^2),
          inc.fit = ifelse(cases_year_sum == 0, NA, fit / cases_year_sum * 10^2),
          inc.fit.lci = ifelse(cases_year_sum == 0, NA, fit.lci / cases_year_sum * 10^2),
          inc.fit.uci = ifelse(cases_year_sum == 0, NA, pmin(fit.uci / cases_year_sum * 10^2, 100)))
  
print(max(plot_dat$inc, na.rm = TRUE))
print(max(plot_dat$inc.fit, na.rm = TRUE))
print(max(plot_dat$inc.fit.uci, na.rm = TRUE))

# plot observed vs posterior predictive virus activity across countries
# Set Y-axis limits and intervals for each virus
y_max <- c(ADV = 65, HMPV = 100, PIV = 80, RSV = 100, RV = 80)

y_by <- c(ADV = 30, HMPV = 50, PIV = 40, RSV = 50, RV = 40)

AAP_ts_country <- ggplot(plot_dat) + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = year_decimal, ymin = inc.fit.lci, ymax = inc.fit.uci), fill = "#D37295", alpha = 0.5) + 
  geom_line(aes(x = year_decimal, y = inc.fit, col = "#D37295"),linewidth=0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(x = year_decimal, y = inc, col = "#499894"),  size=0.8) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab(paste0("RP of ",virus_vars[j]," detections (%)"))+
  scale_colour_identity(name = "",breaks = c("#499894", "#D37295"),labels = c("Observed", "Posterior predicted"),
                        guide = "legend") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2016, 2020, 1), labels = c("2016","2017","2018","2019","2020")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_max[virus_vars[j]]),breaks = seq(0, y_max[virus_vars[j]], by = y_by[virus_vars[j]])) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8),axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8, margin = margin(t = 1, b = 1)),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90,hjust = 0.5,vjust = 0.5),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold",family = "Arial"),
        #panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines"),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())+
  ggtitle(paste0("Pre-COVID-19 pandemic: ",virus_vars[j]))+
  facet_wrap(~country,scales = "fixed", ncol = n_col)
AAP_ts_country

# Store plot
plot_list[[virus_vars[j]]] <- AAP_ts_country

# Number of facet rows for each virus
plot_rows[virus_vars[j]] <- ceiling(
  length(unique(plot_dat$country)) / n_col
)

}

heights_use <- plot_rows + 0.8
heights_use[c("RV","HMPV")] <- heights_use[c("RV","HMPV")] + 0.2

# Combine plots for Supplementary Figure S17 (pre-COVID-19)
figS17 <- ggarrange(plotlist = plot_list[plot_order],
  ncol = 1,nrow = length(plot_order),
  heights = heights_use[plot_order],
  common.legend = TRUE,legend = "bottom",align = "v")
figS17


ggsave(figS17,filename = "FigS17.pdf", device = cairo_pdf, family = "Arial", 
       width = 24,height = sum(plot_rows) * 1.8 + 2,units = "cm")
```
